statements.name: Def_DiscreteTorus
statements.content: A discrete torus on n points is the product Fin n x Fin n.

statements.name: Lem_TorusCard
statements.content: The discrete torus on n points has exactly n^2 elements (its cardinality).
statements.proof: Count the elements of the product set.

statements.name: Thm_Main
statements.content: Main theorem relating the discrete torus to its cardinality.
statements.proof: Combine the definition with the cardinality lemma.
